scope: 134 unique prebuild + search/settings commands, preserving initial, environment repair, and final integration records. Final source includes uncommitted changes at run timestamps.
notes: environment-retry-results.json restored exactly from the complete tool read of retry-results.json immediately before the final integration run overwrote that filename; no timings or statuses inferred.
Per-command .log files hold the most recent execution of that command; the immutable result records retain each execution duration and status.
Activity/foundation/map/photo supplemental suites are recorded separately and are not added to this aggregate count.
